dedupe_keys.name: water demand price and temperature from 2014 to 2018 in hadano city kanagawa prefecture japan

description: Masayoshi Tanishita at Chuo University publishes household water demand, tariff and average-temperature data for Hadano City in Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. The deposit title gives coverage from 2014 to 2018, and the description states that approximately 30,000 households were observed across two years before and three years after a tariff revision. Monthly demand, price and temperature are supplied in hadanogusu.csv and hadanokisu.csv. The April 2021 Zenodo record makes the files free under CC0. The study's reported demand response varies across household groups, providing context for demand or agent-based simulations, not one universal elasticity. Detailed identifiers, units, privacy transformations and the division between the two CSV files remain unknown from the landing page. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies the Hadano data. The files were not downloaded, and the provider's elasticity estimates were not reproduced.
